products.name: Entra Verified ID — Verifiable Credentials — Commercial
products.short_description: Issue and verify digital credentials — stand up Microsoft Entra Verified ID for verifiable, privacy-respecting proof of identity and attributes.
products.description:
Issue and verify digital credentials — stand up Microsoft Entra Verified ID for verifiable, privacy-respecting proof of identity and attributes.

Manual identity/attribute verification (onboarding, proof of employment, access to sensitive resources) is slow and phishable. Entra Verified ID lets your organization issue tamper-evident verifiable credentials and verify others' — this solution stands up the Verified ID service, defines credential types and rules/display, builds an issuance flow (e.g. employee/verification credential), and a verification flow, with governance.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Verified ID service setup (trust system, DID, domain verification)
  • Credential type design — rules & display definitions
  • Issuance flow (issue employee/verification credentials to the wallet)
  • Verification flow (relying-party checks the credential)
  • Governance — revocation, lifecycle, and privacy considerations

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A working Verified ID capability — issue and verify tamper-evident digital credentials for onboarding, access, and proof, privacy-respecting by design.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ENTVID-Discovery.ps1 — Verified ID posture: service availability, onboarded issuer/authority, credential types
    • ENTVID-New-IssuanceRequest.ps1 — build (and only on -Submit, POST) a Verified ID issuance request
    • ENTVID-New-PresentationRequest.ps1 — build (and only on -Submit, POST) a Verified ID verification request
    • ENTVID-Report.ps1 — Verified ID governance report: credential types and issuance/revocation activity
    • ENTVID-Validate.ps1 — validate Verified ID prerequisites: domain well-known, Request Service app, Key Vault ref

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
